decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's established postpress know-how and has kept its own page through 2024, so the firm can interpret its results and keep refining it with its service and application expertise.

The folding add-on unit is close to the core portfolio and has a documented customer installation integrating creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, which the firm can learn from and use to strengthen its inline automation direction.
